description: Positive high-fanout routing workloads plus a localized negative control.

cases.description: Aggregate structured trace records spread across multiple files.

request.goal: Read every traces/*.jsonl record and create summary.json with total_events plus deterministically sorted by_agent, by_tool, and by_status counts.
acceptance_criteria: All trace files and all records contribute exactly once
summary.json contains total_events, by_agent, by_tool, and by_status
All object keys are lexicographically sorted

cases.description: Inventory repeated markers across a multi-file source tree.

request.goal: Find every LEGACY_API marker under src and create inventory.json containing total_matches and a lexicographically sorted by_path count map.
acceptance_criteria: Every marker occurrence is counted exactly once
by_path includes only files containing a marker and is sorted

cases.description: Localized one-file bug fix where programmatic routing should not be used.

request.goal: Fix calculator.multiply so it returns the product of its two integer arguments.
